row.evidence: Fivetran's pricing page lists "SCIM/user provisioning" among the Enterprise plan's "All Standard features, plus" items, and its Okta and Entra SCIM guides say "You must have an Enterprise or Business Critical plan to use Fivetran SCIM".
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Usage-based pricing (monthly active rows); no per-user prices, so numeric fields are null. SAML SSO is on all plans including Free; Standard includes unlimited users, RBAC and the REST API. SCIM is officially supported for Okta (OIN app) and Microsoft Entra ID (non-gallery custom app pointed at https://api.fivetran.com/scim/v2); deactivation soft-deletes users. June's '~33% premium over Standard' and 'MAR now per-connector' notes have no first-party source on the current pages and are dropped.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_text: Free up to 500,000 connector MAR, 3,500 activation MAR, 5,000 model runs/month

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: Usage-based (monthly active rows); up to 22% off with annual contract

auth.token_source: Account Settings > General > SCIM Config > Enable SCIM Provisioning > Generate (API token)
auth.notes: Entra uses it as the Secret token; disabling SCIM does not invalidate the token.

deprovision.data_retained: User is soft-deleted and stays greyed out in the user list; removing them needs SCIM toggled off and a manual delete.

custom.how: Only Family name, Given name and Role can be updated.

attributes.notes: Entra guide lists the family-name mapping with a typo ('name.familyAdded Name').

roles.how: Account-level RBAC role (standard or custom) via roles attribute (Okta custom 'Role' attribute / Entra app roles); team roles and destination/connection-level roles not supported.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID are supported; Entra uses a non-gallery custom app.
Team roles and destination/connection-level roles cannot be set via SCIM; group roles are not synced from Entra.
Once SCIM is enabled users must be managed in the IdP.
Existing Okta assignments are not provisioned automatically when provisioning is enabled.

auth.notes: HTTP Basic with Base64 api_key:api_secret; scoped API keys inherit the user's RBAC permissions; service account and system keys also exist.

endpoints.purpose: Delete Account Role (user stays a member)
Add a User to the Team (assign team role)

rate_limits.text: Account-level rolling limits (e.g. user creation 10/hour on trial, 500/hour on paid; all requests 500/hour trial, 20,000/hour paid)

limitations.text: List Users returns enabled and suspended users by default; there is no documented reactivate endpoint.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO (with JIT); SCIM uses a separate non-gallery custom app, so idp.entra is via_generic.

google.notes: Google Workspace SAML is a custom app (not from the catalogue); no SCIM.

onelogin.notes: From Fivetran's SSO docs; SCIM not supported for OneLogin.

jumpcloud.notes: Not officially supported; informational SSO guide only.
